items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: She's the one you said you grew up with her? Yeah. We come up with that.

ctx.x: Mr. Kimberley, he used to write on the balloon. Yeah. Yeah, I know. I heard of her.
She's the one you said you grew up with her? Yeah. We come up with that. He said he came up with her. No, we live right next door. There was none of that. Yeah.
They lived on the corner. They lived on the corner.
